snippet.title: Dino Topia - Closed Beta Trailer
snippet.description:
🦕 Dino Topia's 1st CBT has officially started! 🦖

🔥The wait is over! The Closed Beta Test for Dino Topia is officially live!
Step into a vibrant world of Dinos, strategic battles, and cozy base-building starting today!

🎮 If you’ve secured a spot, head in and start your adventure now!
🦖 Collect, battle, build... and shape the future of Dino Topia with your feedback!

✨ Haven’t joined the CBT yet? It’s not too late!
🔗Fill out the survey now for a chance to grab one of the remaining slots:
https://forms.gle/WRdH36MGn4tkQwyg8

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336520/Dino_Topia/
Early Access coming in Q3 2025!

Discord: https://discord.gg/eZuzkvKy
X: https://x.com/_dinotopia
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/16bXdt5nyF/?mibextid=wwXIfr
